result.title: Early Stopping in Large Reasoning Models: A Survey and Empirical Audit of Efficiency and Reliability
result.summary: Large reasoning models can improve accuracy by generating longer reasoning traces, but some of this computation may be unnecessary. Early-stopping methods aim to stop once enough reasoning is available to answer. Evaluating these methods requires accounting for the cost of deciding when to stop and the reliability of the resulting answer. We evaluate different methods across five reasoning models on mathematical and scientific reasoning, code generation, and factuality tasks by using a shared rollout replay protocol. We introduce Target-Integrated Token Efficiency (TITE) to measure efficiency relative to the oracle across accuracy targets. We also examine correctness at later exit positions, transfer across models and tasks, post-stop reasoning continuation, and retained justification quality. In our experiments, correctness can decrease at later positions beyond what the fitted decoding-noise model predicts. Reliability checks also reveal continued reasoning after forced termination and weaker supporting reasoning in some correct early-stopping outputs. The implementation can be found in https://github.com/hung20gg/audit-early-stopping.

AI.brief_summary: 该文综述并实证审计大推理模型的早停方法，在五个推理模型、数学与科学推理、代码生成和事实性任务上采用共享 rollout 重放协议进行比较，提出 TITE 指标以衡量相对 oracle 的 token 效率，并额外考察较晚退出位置的正确性、跨模型与跨任务迁移、强制停止后的继续推理以及理由质量保留。
AI.relevance_reason: 其停止代价核算、可靠性检查与「停止后仍继续推理」的审计协议，可供核查 LVR 中 STOP 决策的收益—成本与停止依据是否忠实；但研究对象为纯文本推理链，其指标能否迁移到需要视觉证据获取的 latent 状态停止判断仍需阅读后判断。
